input.quote: The parties agree to the following non-binding sales and marketing cooperation efforts:
input.rationale: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds Corio anywhere in the Agreement, so the clause set meets the preferred position. The Grant of Rights licenses are all expressly "nonexclusive" and impose only scope/IP restrictions (Section 2.7) rather than any requirement that Corio host, promote or source only Commerce One procurement software; Section 2.9 (New Products) merely contemplates future licences on terms to be agreed. The Exhibit D sales and marketing cooperation efforts (Relationship Managers, joint marketing, marketing fund, dedicated personnel) are stated to be "non-binding", and the only commitment there — commercially reasonable efforts to obtain two initial Customers (para 7) — is a soft effort obligation, not exclusive dealing. Section 13 (Shared Resources) is likewise non-restrictive and Section 13.6 expressly preserves each party's independent development rights. The only exclusivity-flavoured terms run in our favour (Section 2.4: Commerce One shall not contact Corio Customers regarding non-ASP licence sales and must refer them to Corio), which is acceptable and not flagged. Corio therefore retains full freedom to procure and host competing applications; no redline needed.
